title: Fix a spelling mistake in README.md in place

targets.behavior: Apply standing in-place edit and scope instructions to an existing README.

prompt: README.md misspells "receive" as "recieve". Fix the spelling in README.md itself. Change nothing else.
check: grep -q 'Workers receive one task' README.md && ! grep -q recieve README.md && test "$(find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | wc -l)" -eq 1

stub.text: Fixed the spelling of receive in README.md.
